translations.Obezite tedavisinde dünya genelinde en ç: One of the most commonly used surgical approaches for obesity. With a laparoscopic technique, most of the stomach is removed to create a smaller sleeve-shaped stomach; this reduces stomach volume and may support appetite control.

translations.Diyet ve egzersizle kilo veremeyen, hafi: A non-surgical endoscopic approach in which botulinum toxin is injected into selected areas of the stomach. It may temporarily reduce gastric muscle activity and slow gastric emptying in appropriate patients.
translations.Tamamen endoskopik bir işlemdir, genel a: It is performed endoscopically and does not require a surgical incision; the type of sedation is determined by the medical team.
translations.Mide asit salgısını da azaltarak açlık k: Its effect on gastric activity may contribute to appetite control in some patients.
translations.Etkisi ortalama 4-6 ay sürer, bu süreçte: The effect is temporary and varies by patient; weight-management results depend on nutrition, activity and individual factors.
translations.Geçmişte bariatrik cerrahi (mide kelepçe: Revision procedures may be considered for patients who have had previous bariatric surgery and later experience inadequate weight loss, weight regain or certain complications. They require careful assessment and specialized surgical expertise.

translations.about.p1: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Erol Vural is a leading surgeon with many years of surgical experience, specializing particularly in bariatric and metabolic surgery as well as advanced laparoscopic procedures in general surgery. He closely follows current treatment protocols in modern medicine and guides his patients toward a healthy, comfortable and sustainable life.
translations.about.p2: After completing his education with outstanding achievements, he completed his general surgery residency and earned the academic title of Associate Professor. Dr. Erol Vural has performed numerous successful bariatric surgery procedures throughout his career and has earned a respected position both nationally and internationally.
translations.about.highlight: “Our goal is not only to create a physical change through weight loss, but also to permanently improve our patients’ quality of life by helping them overcome obesity-related conditions such as Type 2 diabetes, hypertension and sleep apnea.”
translations.about.list1: Bariatric Surgery: Personalized surgical solutions for individuals with excess weight.
translations.about.list2: Sleeve Gastrectomy: A permanent weight-control approach that reduces stomach volume and supports natural appetite control.
translations.about.list3: Metabolic Surgery: Surgical treatment options for patients with Type 2 diabetes that remains uncontrolled despite medication.
translations.about.list4: Revision Surgery: Correction and revision of unsuccessful bariatric procedures previously performed at other centers.
translations.about.list5: Advanced Laparoscopic Surgery: Reliable minimally invasive techniques performed through much smaller incisions than traditional open surgery.
translations.about.p3: Obesity treatment is not limited to a surgical procedure; it is a multidisciplinary process requiring preparation before surgery and long-term follow-up afterward. Dr. Erol Vural and his specialist team, including dietitians, psychologists and patient coordinators, support patients at every step to build the foundation for lasting success.
translations.services.general1: Laparoscopic Gallbladder Surgery: Treatment of gallstones and polyps.
translations.services.general2: Hernia Surgery: Minimally invasive repair of inguinal, umbilical and incisional hernias using mesh when appropriate.
translations.services.general3: Thyroid and Endocrine Surgery: Surgical treatment of goiter and thyroid nodules.
translations.services.general4: Stomach and Intestinal Surgery: Surgery for benign and malignant tumors.

translations.blog.faq1_q: ¿La gastrectomía en manga es lo mismo que la cirugía de reducción de estómago?
translations.blog.faq1_a: Sí. En el uso cotidiano, “cirugía de reducción de estómago” suele referirse a la gastrectomía en manga. La indicación y la elección del procedimiento requieren una evaluación médica.
translations.blog.faq2_q: ¿Es mejor el bypass gástrico que la gastrectomía en manga?
translations.blog.faq2_a: No existe una única opción mejor para todas las personas. El IMC, el reflujo, la diabetes tipo 2, los tratamientos previos y el estado general de salud se valoran conjuntamente.
translations.blog.faq3_q: ¿El balón gástrico o el botox gástrico pueden sustituir a la cirugía?
translations.blog.faq3_a: Son opciones no quirúrgicas/endoscópicas y no son el mismo procedimiento que la gastrectomía en manga o el bypass gástrico. La indicación y los resultados esperados deben valorarse individualmente.
translations.blog.faq4_q: ¿Por qué son necesarios los controles periódicos después de una gastrectomía en manga?
translations.blog.faq4_a: La nutrición, las vitaminas y minerales, los cambios de peso y los posibles síntomas son partes importantes del seguimiento a largo plazo.
